note: The research tree screen's host (menu 135, OZL_TreeMenu.Init): the whole screen dimmed, a loading line, and an invisible probe frame. Which window to show is known only when the server answers (OZL_TreeView.Skin), so the window of the faction's skin (ozl_tree_<skin>.layout, root TreeWindow) is created INTO this host then, on top of everything here. TreeProbe has no look of its own: the menu moves it twice in its first frames to measure what SetPos/SetSize take on this screen (source/ui/SKINS.md, 'Units').

panel.name: TreeDim
panel.note: Dims the world behind the screen; the skin's own window covers it with its desk or casing.

label.name: TreeLoading
label.note: Shown until the answer of the server arrives; the menu hides it when the window is built.

frame.name: TreeProbe
frame.note: The SetPos/SetSize probe: no look, never seen.
